blurb: Guests can stay in park models or RV sites with full hook-ups and enjoy amenities including a 9-hole par 33 golf course, two fishing lakes for catch and release, swimming pool, spa, billiards, exercise room, and a variety of sports and activities. The resort operates year-round with an activities director available November through March.
extraNote: Park model rental requires $1100 refundable security deposit · Cancellation requires 60 day written notice for park models; $200 administration fee withheld · Site rental reservations of one month or longer require $300 deposit applied to last month's rent · Site rental cancellation requires 30 day notice with $100 fee; $300 fee if less than 30 days · No refunds for early departure on discounted rates · Year-round
